title: AI Chat: wire external MCP servers with per-call approval, cloud privacy gate, and scoped undo

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: area:mcp
labels.description: MCP server and agent tooling (crates/app/src/mcp, camcraft-mcp skill)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Wire opt-in external MCP servers (starting with a SolidCraft preset) into CamCraft's AI Chat panel and worker (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/ai_chat/`).

## Scope
- Add a server list and SolidCraft quick preset (`solidcraft-cli mcp` or `--connect`) in the AI Chat configuration UI. Servers stay disabled until the user enables and trusts them.
- Route `<server_id>__<tool>` calls in `worker.rs` and `worker_mcp.rs` to the external MCP client while built-in tools keep using the in-process `Inbox::channel` and `LiveGate` (`crates/app/src/mcp/live.rs`).
- Enforce default-deny inline Allow/Deny confirmation for every external tool call, showing server name, tool name, and exact arguments. Allow optional auto-approval only when the user enables `allow_read_only_auto` for that server and the tool declares MCP `annotations.readOnlyHint: true` and `annotations.destructiveHint: false`. Disable external servers completely in `FallbackMode::ReadOnly`.
- Enforce privacy for cloud presets: block an external server on `EndpointKind::Cloud` presets unless `allow_cloud_data` is enabled for that server, cap external replies with `budget::cap_tool_reply`, and strip MCP `image` and binary `resource` blocks on cloud presets by default (replacing them with a short text note).
- Keep `Undo Turn` and `Ctrl+Z` scoped strictly to CamCraft's `History` batch. Never send automatic remote `undo` calls to SolidCraft. When a turn calls any mutating external tool, show a clear notice on the turn card that SolidCraft edits remain in SolidCraft's own undo history.

Done means: `egui_kittest` tests with a fake stdio MCP server and `ScriptedTransport` verify untrusted servers never spawn, external calls pause on Allow/Deny, `offline_only` and `allow_cloud_data: false` block cloud presets, cloud presets strip external image blocks by default, and `Undo Turn` reverts only CamCraft's `History` batch with the scoped-undo notice.

Part of #3793
